title: GPT-6.1 Sol paste extraction verified
summary: Use GPT-6.1 Sol to organize pasted product notes into reviewable form fields.

changes.detail: Protected, rate-limited server endpoint using exact gpt-6.1-sol model, low reasoning, strict JSON schema, server-only key and store:false. Extracted values must occur in the source before existing field validation.

AI analysis is the primary paste action; structured local parsing remains available. Shows loading/errors and disclosure; cancels stale requests when pasted text changes. Field preview and selection remain required.
Explicit stock-unit text now normalizes safely; extraction prompt asks for the stock number. Added local and AI interaction coverage plus setup documentation.

validation.name: Local automated checks
validation.detail: 12 tests passed covering parsing, exact model/schema configuration, unsupported values, authorization, selected-field application and stale AI response cancellation. Optional live test skipped in the normal run.

validation.name: Live GPT-6.1 Sol test
validation.detail: Synthetic free-form product sentence extracted name, price and stock correctly after stock-unit correction; 4/4 tests passed in the live-enabled service suite. No real product writes.

validation.name: TypeScript and focused lint
validation.detail: Full repository TypeScript check passed. Focused lint for paste component, AI service and endpoint passed without warnings or errors.

validation.name: Browser and deployment
validation.detail: No browser visual/authenticated end-to-end verification or deployment performed.
